content.text:
## Findings (high effort)

After scanning through all 8 review angles (line-by-line diff, removed behaviors, cross-file traces, reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude, and conventions), I found one critical correctness bug:

```json
[
  {
    "file": "math.ts",
    "line": 2,
    "summary": "add() function returns subtraction instead of addition",
    "failure_scenario": "add(5, 3) returns -2 instead of 8; any caller expecting the sum of two numbers receives their difference"
  }
]
```

The function named `add` performs `a - b` instead of `a + b`. This is a fundamental logic error where the operator was changed from `+` (in the committed version) to `-` (in the current working tree).
